description: Add the new configure commands and wire them into the CLI; deprecate the two legacy commands. New: 'configure set-tenant [<tenant_name>]' (interactive tenant setup, like 'configure set' minus the project prompt, writes a [tenant <name>] section including the freshly generated access_token + expiry), 'configure set-profile [<profile_name>]' (prompts for an existing tenant_name + project_name, resolves project_id, writes a [profile <name>]/[default] section), and 'configure export <profile>' (emits four shell export lines for the resolved, tenant-merged profile with a fresh token). Deprecate (stderr warning, still functional) 'configure set' and 'tokens export'. Update configure_list to the two-level format, register the new subcommands, and update CLI help/docstrings. Depends on FEAT-001's data layer.
steps: Create src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/configure_set_tenant.py with a docopt `Command` class modeled on configure_set.py but WITHOUT the project_name prompt or project-id resolution. Usage: `icav2 configure set-tenant [<tenant_name>] [--no-encrypt] [--public-key=<path>] [--private-key=<path>]`, plus a help form. Default tenant name 'default'. Prompt server_url (default ica.illumina.com) and x_api_key; validate the key via TokenManager._generate_token (TokenManager(tenant_name=..., config_path=CONFIG_FILE_PATH)); handle encryption of the api key and access token exactly as configure_set does (DEFAULT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH/DEFAULT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH, --no-encrypt, generate-keys tip). Extract the token expiry from the JWT. Load existing config via ConfigParser.parse_file -> (tenants, profiles) (start with empty maps on ConfigParseError), upsert a TenantConfig for the tenant name (server_url, x_api_key, encryption keys, access_token, access_token_expiry), and write_file(CONFIG_FILE_PATH, tenants, profiles). Print a success line and whether the key/token are stored encrypted.

Create src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/configure_set_profile.py with a docopt `Command`. Usage: `icav2 configure set-profile [<profile_name>]` plus a help form; default profile name 'default'. Load config via ConfigParser.parse_file -> (tenants, profiles). Prompt tenant_name: if it is not a key in tenants, print an error to stderr naming the missing tenant and listing the available tenants, then sys.exit(1). Prompt project_name and output_format (default 'table', validate against VALID_OUTPUT_FORMATS). Resolve project_id using the referenced tenant: derive base_url from the tenant's server_url, obtain a valid token (TokenManager(tenant_name=...).get_valid_token(api_key=tenant.x_api_key, base_url=..., cached_token=tenant.access_token)), and resolve the name->id via config_helpers.get_project_id_from_project_name_curl (or the same _resolve_project_id approach configure_set uses). Upsert a ProfileConfig(name, project_id, project_name, tenant_name, output_format) into profiles and write_file(CONFIG_FILE_PATH, tenants, profiles). Do NOT prompt for or write server_url / x_api_key.

Create src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/configure_export.py with a docopt `Command`. Usage: `icav2 configure export <profile>` plus a help form. Resolve the profile via ProfileResolver(config_path=CONFIG_FILE_PATH, cli_profile=<profile>).resolve(). Obtain a fresh access token via TokenManager(tenant_name=config.tenant_name, config_path=CONFIG_FILE_PATH, private/public key paths from config).get_valid_token(api_key=config.api_key, base_url=config.base_url, cached_token=config.cached_access_token) (refresh if stale). Print EXACTLY four lines to stdout, in order: `export ICAV2_SERVER_URL=<server_url>`, `export ICAV2_BASE_URL=https://<server_url>/ica/rest`, `export ICAV2_PROJECT_ID=<project_id>`, `export ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN=<access_token>`. First-line format must match exactly `export ICAV2_SERVER_URL=ica.illumina.com`.

Register the new subcommands in src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/__init__.py: add 'set-tenant' -> configure_set_tenant, 'set-profile' -> configure_set_profile, 'export' -> configure_export to CONFIGURE_SUBCOMMANDS, and update the module docstring's subcommand list.

Update src/icav2_cli_plugins/utils/cli.py: in the `cmd == 'configure'` branch's inline `_print_configure_help`, add lines for set-tenant, set-profile, and export, and mark `set` as deprecated. Update the top-level module docstring where it documents configure/tokens as needed (note 'configure set' and 'tokens export' as deprecated).

Add a stderr deprecation warning at the start of src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/configure_set.py `Command.__call__` pointing users to `icav2 configure set-tenant` + `icav2 configure set-profile`, then keep it functional. Adapt configure_set to the FEAT-001 ConfigParser tuple API so it still writes a usable config (e.g. write both a [tenant <name>] section and a [profile <name>] section derived from its prompts, or clearly keep its existing single-flow behavior under the deprecation); whichever path is chosen, parse_file/write_file calls must use the (tenants, profiles) signatures.

Add a stderr deprecation warning at the start of src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/tokens/export.py `TokensExport.__call__` pointing users to `icav2 configure export`, then still print the resolved token.

Update src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/configure_list.py `__call__` to the (tenants, profiles) API: list tenants and, for each profile, show the tenant it references. Keep the 'no profiles configured' path working when both maps are empty.

Update tests in tests/test_configure_set.py to the two-level ConfigParser API and assert the deprecation warning is emitted on stderr while the command still writes a config. In tests/test_configure_commands.py add coverage: set-tenant writes a [tenant] section containing access_token + access_token_expiry and no project_id/project_name; set-profile errors (SystemExit, stderr lists available tenants) when the entered tenant does not exist and, when it does, writes a profile with project_id/project_name/tenant_name/output_format; export prints exactly the four export lines with ICAV2_BASE_URL derived as https://<server_url>/ica/rest; tokens export emits a deprecation warning on stderr but still prints the token. Mock requests.post (token generation) and requests.get (project list) as the existing configure/token tests do; use tmp_path for the config file.
acceptance_criteria: `configure set-tenant` writes a [tenant <name>] section with server_url, x_api_key, encryption keys, access_token and access_token_expiry, and does not write any project fields.

`configure set-profile` refuses an unknown tenant with a stderr message listing available tenants, and otherwise writes a [profile <name>]/[default] section with project_id, project_name, tenant_name, output_format and no server_url/x_api_key.

`configure export <profile>` prints exactly four lines: export ICAV2_SERVER_URL=..., export ICAV2_BASE_URL=https://<server_url>/ica/rest, export ICAV2_PROJECT_ID=..., export ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN=..., using tenant-merged values and a fresh token.
`configure set` and `tokens export` each print a deprecation warning to stderr pointing at their replacement and still perform their original function.
set-tenant/set-profile/export are registered in CONFIGURE_SUBCOMMANDS and appear in `icav2 configure` help; set is marked deprecated in help.
Running `uv run pytest tests/ -p no:orcabus_pipeline_test_utils` passes except the single documented pre-existing test_cli_unit delegation failure.

findings:
All FEAT-002 steps implemented against the FEAT-001 two-level (tenants, profiles) data layer.

NEW COMMANDS (src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/):
- configure_set_tenant.py: `icav2 configure set-tenant [<tenant_name>] [--no-encrypt] [--public-key] [--private-key]` (default name 'default'). Prompts server_url (default ica.illumina.com) + x_api_key only (NO project prompt). Validates key via TokenManager(tenant_name=..., config_path=CONFIG_FILE_PATH)._generate_token; encrypts api key + access token when DEFAULT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH exists (same flow as configure_set, generate-keys tip on miss); extracts JWT exp -> access_token_expiry. Loads config via parse_file->(tenants,profiles) (empty maps on ConfigParseError), upserts TenantConfig, write_file(path, tenants, profiles). Prints success + encrypted-at-rest notices.
- configure_set_profile.py: `icav2 configure set-profile [<profile_name>]` (default 'default'). parse_file->(tenants,profiles); prompts tenant_name and if absent from tenants prints stderr error naming missing tenant + sorted available tenants and sys.exit(1). Prompts project_name + output_format (default 'table', validated vs VALID_OUTPUT_FORMATS). Resolves project_id using the tenant: base_url=https://<tenant.server_url>/ica/rest, TokenManager(tenant_name=...).get_valid_token(api_key=tenant.x_api_key, base_url, cached_token=tenant.access_token), then a configure_set-style static _resolve_project_id via requests.get (mockable). Upserts slim ProfileConfig(name, project_id, project_name, tenant_name, output_format); NO server_url/x_api_key written.
- configure_export.py: `icav2 configure export <profile>`. ProfileResolver(config_path, cli_profile=<profile>).resolve(); if no env token, TokenManager(tenant_name=config.tenant_name, private/public key paths from config).get_valid_token(...). Prints EXACTLY four lines: export ICAV2_SERVER_URL=<server_url>, export ICAV2_BASE_URL=https://<server_url>/ica/rest, export ICAV2_PROJECT_ID=<project_id>, export ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN=<token>.

DEPRECATIONS (still functional, stderr warning at start of __call__):
- configure_set.py: warns pointing to set-tenant + set-profile; adapted to the tuple API -> now writes BOTH a TenantConfig (server_url/x_api_key/encryption keys/token/expiry, keyed by the entered tenant_name or falling back to the profile name) AND a slim ProfileConfig (project_id/project_name/tenant_name). TokenManager constructed with tenant_name=. 
- tokens/export.py: warns pointing to `icav2 configure export`, still prints the resolved ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN.

WIRING:
- configure/__init__.py CONFIGURE_SUBCOMMANDS gained set-tenant/set-profile/export (before set/list/generate-keys); module docstring updated.
- cli.py inline _print_configure_help lists set-tenant/set-profile/export/list/generate-keys and marks set '(deprecated)'; top-level module docstring notes 'tokens export' deprecated and updates the configure line.
- configure_list.py rewritten to (tenants, profiles): prints a Tenant/Server-URL table then a Profile/Tenant/Project table; empty-both path still prints 'No profiles configured.'

TESTS:
- tests/test_configure_set.py rewritten to the two-level API; asserts the deprecation warning on stderr and that a tenant + profile are written.
- tests/test_configure_commands.py rewritten: set-tenant writes [tenant] with access_token + access_token_expiry and no profiles; set-profile errors (SystemExit, stderr lists available tenants) on unknown tenant and otherwise writes a profile with project_id/project_name/tenant_name/output_format; export prints exactly the four lines with ICAV2_BASE_URL=https://<server_url>/ica/rest; configure set deprecated-still-writes; list two-level + empty states; tokens export deprecation warning + still prints token. Uses _make_jwt (HS256) for real exp claims; mocks requests.post / requests.get; tmp_path config.
